# fn-2-29o.1 Add data-testid attributes to ImportDialog

## Description
Add `data-testid` attributes to ImportDialog component for reliable E2E test selection.

## Files to Change

- `src/components/Dialogs/ImportDialog.tsx`

## Changes

1. Add `data-testid="section-name-input"` to the section name input field (line ~62-68)
2. Add `data-testid="import-section-dialog"` to the `role="dialog"` element (line ~235)

## Code Reference

```tsx
// Line ~62-68 - Add data-testid to input
<input
  type="text"
  data-testid="section-name-input"  // ADD THIS
  value={name}
  onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
  className="w-full"
  placeholder="e.g., Main Line"
/>

// Line ~235 DialogWrapper - Add data-testid on role="dialog"
<div 
  role="dialog" 
  aria-modal="true" 
  aria-labelledby="dialog-title"
  data-testid="import-section-dialog"  // ADD THIS
  className="..."
>
```

## Why

The WebdriverIO test uses selectors like `input[name*="section"]` which don't match. Using `data-testid` is the recommended approach per CLAUDE.md conventions.
## Acceptance
- [ ] ImportDialog.tsx has `data-testid="section-name-input"` on the section name input
- [ ] ImportDialog.tsx has `data-testid="import-section-dialog"` on the `role="dialog"` element
- [ ] TypeScript compiles without errors (`pnpm tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] Existing Playwright tests pass (`pnpm test:ui`)

# fn-2-29o.2 Add data-testid to DmpImportDialog

## Description
Add `data-testid` attribute to DmpImportDialog for consistency and test disambiguation.

## Files to Change

- `src/components/Dialogs/DmpImportDialog.tsx`

## Changes

1. Add `data-testid="import-dmp-dialog"` to the `role="dialog"` element (line ~340)

## Code Reference

```tsx
// In DialogWrapper, add to the div with role="dialog"
<div 
  role="dialog" 
  aria-modal="true" 
  aria-labelledby="dialog-title"
  data-testid="import-dmp-dialog"  // ADD THIS
  className="..."
>
```

## Why

Distinguishes DmpImportDialog (opened by Ctrl+I) from ImportDialog (manual section creation). Tests can now reliably identify which dialog is open.
## Acceptance
- [ ] DmpImportDialog.tsx has `data-testid="import-dmp-dialog"` on the `role="dialog"` element
- [ ] TypeScript compiles without errors (`pnpm tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] Existing Playwright tests pass (`pnpm test:ui`)

# fn-2-29o.4 Update TESTING.md documentation

## Description
Update TESTING.md to clarify the two import dialogs and correct close behaviors.

## Files to Change

- `TESTING.md`

## Changes

Add/update sections to clarify:

1. **Dialog disambiguation**: 
   - `Ctrl+I` opens DmpImportDialog (for .dmp file import)
   - ImportDialog (for manual section creation) is opened via store

2. **Recommended approach**:
   - Use `__E2E_TEST__.uiStore.getState().openDialog('...')` for reliable dialog opening
   - Use Cancel button to close (Escape support added separately)

3. **Available dialogs**:
   | Dialog | activeDialog value | Opened by |
   |--------|-------------------|-----------|
   | DmpImportDialog | `'import-dmp'` | Ctrl+I |
   | ImportDialog | `'import'` | Store only |
## Acceptance
- [ ] TESTING.md clarifies that Ctrl+I opens DmpImportDialog
- [ ] TESTING.md documents recommended dialog opening approach
- [ ] TESTING.md lists available dialogs with their activeDialog values
